summary: NL2SQL — 프리셋에 없는 질문("잔여석 비율 10% 이하"). Claude가 run_sql로 SQL을 만들고 검증 통과, LIMIT 500 보강

value.answer: 매진이 임박한(잔여석 10% 이하) 오늘 회차는 1개입니다. (19시 42분 기준)
value.sql: SELECT m.title AS movie_title, t.name AS theater_name, s.starts_at, s.remaining_seats, s.total_seats, ROUND(1.0 * s.remaining_seats / s.total_seats, 3) AS remaining_ratio FROM screening s JOIN movie m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id JOIN theater t ON t.theater_id = s.theater_id WHERE s.business_date = '2026-11-17' AND s.starts_at > '2026-11-17 19:42' AND s.total_seats > 0 AND 1.0 * s.remaining_seats / s.total_seats <= 0.1 ORDER BY remaining_ratio LIMIT 500
